title: WL94C - panel-mediated query-level supervision smoke: per-(lighting, patch) emphasis of panel-dominated box queries (D) vs matched non-panel box queries (E) inside the WL94A 50/50 stream
brief: user brief 'WL94C - Panel-Mediated Query-Level Supervision Smoke' (2026-11-14)
batch_class: suffix of WL94 (bounded continuation of WL94B under the preserved ECRO contract; only the per-query supervision weights change). Named WL94C by the brief; the owner decides; no historical number changes.

hypothesis.H-Q: the existing ECRO better preserves sharp-panel transport if physically identified panel-mediated receiver/patch queries receive sufficient training emphasis, beyond the effect of equivalent emphasis on matched non-panel queries

preserved: OWN objective terms and targets (sum vs f, S vs e2, G vs e3), den, Adam 3e-4 warm-up 200 cosine to 1e-5, clip 10, 2,000 steps
WL94A C item list, rank-parity 50/50 material assignment, cached targets, item order rng(seed + 94), init own_s<seed> + extended buffer
frozen own_s8601 / own_s8602; WL94 / WL94A / WL94B checkpoints, tables, renders, audit aggregates (read-only links)
WL94 / WL94A / WL94B code (imported unchanged) and labels
query: one (item, lighting, receiver patch) = the 64 bins x 3 channels of that patch's table under that lighting; Q = 4 x 1,270 = 5,080 queries per item
path_labels: WL94B audit aggregates (results/audit/tgt): per query the loss-normalised mass of e2_p / e2_o / e3_p / e3_o from the split re-render with the target seeds (parts = stored f to 4.7e-8, e2_p + e2_o = f2 to 5.8e-8); independent 64-spp realization (results/audit/ind) for reliability. The model does not expose e2_p / e3_p: the weights multiply the EXISTING e2 / e3 / sum terms of the query; no isolated panel component is predicted or supervised.
selection_D: panel-dominated box query: receiver patch on a Lambert box face (box A or B) with pm_q = (e2_p + e3_p) / total loss-normalised mass >= 0.5 (TAU). Seed-independent.
selection_E: matched negative control, per seed: the same TOTAL number of box queries as D, drawn from the SAME material half (any item) among box queries with a positive target and pm_q < 0.10 (TAU_E, not in D), by an optimal one-to-one assignment (Hungarian, scipy linear_sum_assignment) minimising |d log err0| / SD + |d log exitance| / SD + 1.0 x [box A/B differs] (SD over positive-target box queries of the seed); err0 = the frozen own_s<seed> per-query objective error (non-training instrumentation of the initialization), exitance = the query's target exitance. Controls receiver category (box, and A vs B), query count, target magnitude and initial difficulty (hard-example effect).
weights: per item: KAPPA = 8 on the k selected queries, (Q - 8 k) / (Q - k) on the others, so the item mean weight is exactly 1 (same per-step and total supervision budget as C); items without selected queries are unchanged. D and E have the same total number of emphasised queries; E's queries lie mostly in other items of the same half, so per-item counts differ while every item keeps mean weight 1. The weight multiplies all three normalised squared terms of the query; the gradient uses the weighted objective, the training log records the UNWEIGHTED terms (comparable with C).
why_kappa_8: pre-freeze analytic accounting (WL94B aggregates, before any candidate training): selected queries carry 0.20 % of the loss mass and 27 % of the box panel-mediated mass; KAPPA = 4 gives ~1.8x box panel-mediated exposure (below the 2x contract), KAPPA = 8 ~2.9x. The smallest power of two meeting the contract with margin; one value, no sweep.

feasibility_gates (pre-freeze computed a.G_REL: D selection agreement with the independent realization >= 0.80
feasibility_gates (pre-freeze computed a.G_EXPO_D: D stream (C's realized item counts) box panel-mediated weighted loss-mass share >= 2.0 x C AND D-query weighted share >= 4.0 x C
feasibility_gates (pre-freeze computed a.G_EXPO_E: E stream box panel-mediated share <= 1.10 x C
feasibility_gates (pre-freeze computed a.G_MATCH: |standardised mean difference| <= 0.10 for log err0 and log exitance (D vs E pairs), mean pm of E <= 0.05, no unmatched D query

evaluation: own (frozen anchor), C (WL94A), D, E; arms C0 and C2_srcS1 (exact panel sender); WL94B metric definitions: untextured / textured ROI_T E_H + signed + noise bound, panel-face panel-sender rel L1 / signed vs e2_p, panel-face G rel L1 / signed vs e3, CK2 box-A amplitudes / corr, image texture-response slope / corr, F2, MR (table + V_ck population), V_orig / V_ck rel L1

criteria.sharp_compare: for models x, y: x better than y if E_H(y) - E_H(x) > tol, tol = max(2 x max(noise bounds), 0.005) (untextured ROI_T, C0)
criteria.own_anchor: SHARP_OK_vs_own: E_H(x) <= E_H(own) + tol (reported for every candidate)
criteria.components: X improved vs Y if rel_l1(X) <= 0.8 rel_l1(Y) and rel_l1(Y) - rel_l1(X) > 2 x reference half noise (panel-face sender, panel-face G)

outcome.PANEL_SPECIFIC_IMPROVEMENT: on both seeds: D better than C AND D better than E AND D keeps F2 and MR
outcome.GENERIC_SUPERVISION_EFFECT: on both seeds: D better than C AND E better than C AND (D not distinguishable from E on both seeds, or D worse than E on both seeds)
outcome.NO_RELIABLE_IMPROVEMENT: D better than C on neither seed
outcome.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else (seed disagreement, F2 / MR loss with improvement, init mismatch, non-finite steps)

criteria.precedence: STOP, then in the order listed

answers_mapping: exposure increased = G_EXPO_D values; panel-specific / sender / global / sharp improved: YES both seeds, NO neither, MIXED otherwise; F2 / MR per seed; sharp at own level reported separately
stops: reference noise: inherited WL94 CK2 reference S/N (table median >= 4: 990-3,950)
pre_freeze_exposure: All WL94 / WL94A / WL94B results are known. Pre-freeze feasibility (no training) ran in ~/rest_x94cfeas: the manifest step (selection, own initial per-query errors on the 96 training items, matching, weights, accounting, gates), three times, plus one matching probe printing balance values only; see pre_freeze_refinement. A dev chain (~/rest_x94cdev, 60 steps, 32-spp renders) checks the training / evaluation path; its candidate outputs are not opened. No candidate output exists before the freeze. The dev chain ran end to end (4 trainings, tables, renders, analysis, figures); its manifest reported T_BUDGET false only because the 60-step dev stream makes the visit comparison small-sample (D / E 584 / 594 and 650 / 604; the 2,000-step feasibility run passes at 0.3 %), and its final step printed a dev outcome label (60 steps, 32 spp; not evidence, not used). Dev tables, renders and figures were not opened.

pre_freeze_refinement: Feasibility run 1 (greedy same-item matching on raw log covariates) failed G_MATCH (SMD log err0 0.12 / 0.17, log exitance 0.21 / 0.23). Run 2 (Hungarian, same item, box penalty) failed exitance balance (0.49 / 0.54): log(1e-30) of zero-target box queries (e.g. faces on the floor) inflated the exitance SD to 19.5. A matching probe (balance values only) then compared same-item vs same-half pools with positive-target candidates: same-item stays above 0.10 (0.13-0.19), the same-half pool with a box penalty gives 0.06 / 0.05. Adopted before the freeze: same-half pool, positive-target candidates, Hungarian, box penalty 1.0. TAU, TAU_E, KAPPA, the D rule and every gate threshold are unchanged.
